meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能帮你浏览 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 网站，挑选和提交实验协议、配置参数、下载输入模板，也能用 EstiMate 评估自定义实验方案。
howto.when: 当你想做蛋白质表达与纯化、定量检测、mRNA 合成等实验，或想使用 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 时。

say.text: 帮我提交一个 cell-free 表达纯化 A280 的协议。
say.note: Claude 会引导选择协议并配置参数。

say.text: 用 EstiMate 评估我的自定义实验方案。
say.note: 它会读取描述并给出可行性评估和报价。

say.text: 查一下 IVT mRNA 合成协议的价格和周转时间。
say.note: Claude 会从目录中获取信息。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude help you browse the Ginkgo Cloud Lab website, select and submit experimental protocols, configure parameters, download input templates, and use EstiMate to evaluate custom protocol feasibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants protein expression, quantification, mRNA synthesis, etc., or other Ginkgo Cloud Lab interactions.

say_en.text: Help me submit a cell-free expression and A280 purification protocol.
say_en.note: Guides you through protocol selection and setup.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to assess my custom experimental plan.
say_en.note: It returns a feasibility assessment and pricing.

say_en.text: Check the price and turnaround time for IVT mRNA synthesis.
say_en.note: Claude fetches details from the catalog.
